title: Elegant Briny Kenyan Napa Cabbage Stew
description: This Kenyan-inspired stew features tender Napa cabbage and a blend of aromatic spices, all wrapped up in a traditional banana leaf vessel. It's a high-protein, meal-prep friendly dish perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, knead together chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger until well combined.
Add cumin seeds, coriander seeds, turmeric powder, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and mix until the chicken is evenly coated with the spice mixture.
Add the chopped Napa cabbage to the bowl and mix until the cabbage is evenly distributed.
Lay a banana leaf flat on a work surface and place one quarter of the cabbage and chicken mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the banana leaf over the filling to form a tight packet and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the packets in a large baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
